name: smwgraphics-various-blocks
title: Various Blocks
description:
This is a small random collection of blocks I have made for my hack.
People really liked these when I had them test my hack so I figured why not just submit them?

This pack features.
- animated ?-blocks
- animated turnblocks
- used block
- infinite throwblock
- various solid block designs in 16x16 and 32x32 sizes.
